feeds.title: UK Defence Journal
feeds.description: The UK Defence Journal is dedicated to providing impartial and complete coverage of defence matters in the United Kingdom. Our aim is to become an internationally renowned and trusted defence media source. Subscribe to keep up with latest defence news from the UK and key international insight.

feeds.title: Think Defence
feeds.description: Think Defence is a blog about UK defence issues, no campaign, no pretension and no hidden agendas. Subscribe to keep up with with latest news, views, analysis and media covering UK defence and security.

feeds.title: Defence Blog » UK
feeds.description: This section of the Defence Blog covers the latest defense news and analysis from the UK. Defence Blog is your reliable news source of everything that you need to know about what is going on in the military community and abroad including military vehicles & equipment, breaking news, international news, and more.

feeds.title: Defence Online
feeds.description: Get the latest news, views and features from across the defence sector featuring: Land, Air, Sea, and Homeland.

feeds.title: Defence Viewpoints from UK Defence Forum
feeds.description: Get Up-to-the-minute perspectives on defence, security and peace issues from and for policy makers and opinion leaders.

feeds.title: Thin Pinstriped Line
feeds.description: A blog about UK defence issues which tries to put a positive and fresh look at many current matters impacting UK and wider defence.

feeds.title: Defence Equipment & Support
feeds.description: From the procurement of clothes to carriers, food to fighter jets, Defence Equipment & Support ensure our UK military customers - the Royal Navy, the British Army, and the Royal Air Force - have the equipment and support they need to carry out their duties effectively. Read the latest news and updates from DE&S, part of the Ministry of Defence. Follow for the latest from our military acquisition programs for the UK armed forces.

feeds.title: GOV.UK » Ministry of Defence
feeds.description: We protect the security, independence and interests of our country at home and abroad. We work with our allies and partners whenever possible. Our aim is to ensure that the armed forces have the training, equipment and support necessary for their work, and that we keep within budget.

feeds.title: UK Armed Forces Commentary
feeds.description: UK Armed Forces Commentary offers news, rumors, analysis, and assorted ramblings on the strategies, the missions, the procurement of kits, and the future of the Armed Forces.

feeds.title: UK Defence Solutions Centre
feeds.description: Created as part of the implementation plan for the Defence Growth Partnership (DGP) and jointly funded by government and industry, the UKDSC works closely with the UK's MOD, BEIS, and Department for International Trade - UK Defence & Security Exports (DIT DSE), the UK defense industry and academia.

feeds.title: Transparency International Defence & Security
feeds.description: Transparency International - Defence & Security is one of Transparency International's global programs and is committed to tackling corruption in the global defense and security sector. Located in London, as part of Transparency International's UK chapter, our program works with defense institutions, governments, the defense industry, civil society, and international organizations.

feeds.title: Defence-In-Depth
feeds.description: Defence-in-Depth is the research blog of the Defence Studies Department, King's College London, offering in-depth contemporary and historical analysis of the issues behind defence.

feeds.title: Defence Growth Partnership
feeds.description: The DGP works to secure a truly competitive, sustainable, and globally successful UK Defence sector that provides the leading-edge capability and through-life support for our Armed Forces and International customers, as well as bringing more comprehensive economic benefits to the UK

feeds.title: Janes
feeds.description: Read the latest defense and security news from Janes - the trusted source for defense intelligence. In a world crowded with increasingly unreliable information, our customers require timely, verified, validated, unbiased, and relevant defense, threat, and equipment intelligence. The interconnectivity of Janes assured open-source intelligence and analysis enables us to provide you with the unique insights required to make mission-critical decisions.
